label: 根视口是 1920×1080（无头默认 64×64，不设的话控件坐标全错）
开局：标题屏那颗没有名字，按唯一可见文字点「开始游戏」
推进 10 个逻辑步（不等墙钟）
命令栏「停靠」：开出目的地弹层
选「贫城」——这一按就是 Dock 动词
等它从野地开到贫城并靠上（40 米 = 1000 步，留余量）
真的停住了
修理的前置条件：把饭馆打掉 20 点耐久（eval 只摆条件，不动被验的动词）
饭馆耐久真的掉到 80/100
修理的第二个前置条件：饭馆里有一名在岗工人
w1 的岗位写在活物段那一格
俯视甲板，扫出饭馆的屏幕点，再走玩家那一条右键入口开建筑菜单
eval: var b = Main.World!.Voyage.Position; Main.CameraSetPose((float)b.X, (float)b.Z, 105f, 205f, 80f); if (!Main.World.CanRepair("restaurant")) throw new System.Exception("blocker=" + Main.World.RepairBlockerOf("restaurant")); var p = Main.Picker; string hit = ""; for (int y = 40; y < 1040 && hit == ""; y += 4) { for (int x = 40; x < 1880 && hit == ""; x += 4) { var r = p.Pick(new Godot.Vector2(x, y)); if (r.Target == DemoFactory.Prototypes.BeastArena.Ui.PickTarget.Building && r.BuildingId == "restaurant") hit = x + "," + y; } } if (hit == "") throw new System.Exception("no-restaurant"); var parts = hit.Split(','); var mi = Main.GetType().GetMethod("OnWorldRightClicked", System.Reflection.BindingFlags.NonPublic | System.Reflection.BindingFlags.Instance); mi!.Invoke(Main, new object[] { new Godot.Vector2(int.Parse(parts[0]), int.Parse(parts[1])) }); var mf = Main.GetType().GetField("_buildingMenu", System.Reflection.BindingFlags.NonPublic | System.Reflection.BindingFlags.Instance); var menu = (Godot.Control)mf!.GetValue(Main)!; if (!menu.Visible) throw new System.Exception("menu-closed at " + hit); return "opened " + hit;

label: 建筑菜单「修理」那一颗：这一按就是 RepairBuilding 动词
修理那一发成了
收起建筑菜单：不挡后面的面板
eval: var f = Main.GetType().GetField("_buildingMenu", System.Reflection.BindingFlags.NonPublic | System.Reflection.BindingFlags.Instance); ((DemoFactory.Prototypes.BeastArena.Ui.BuildingMenu)f!.GetValue(Main)!).Close(); return "closed";

label: 卖明星的前置条件：把 g1 的个人名声抬到 100（eval 只摆条件）
eval: var u = Main.World!.Roster.Find("g1")!; u.PersonalReputation = 100.0; return "rep=" + u.PersonalReputation;

label: 俯视甲板，扫出 g1 的屏幕点，再走玩家那一条左键入口选中他
eval: var p = Main.Picker; string hit = ""; for (int y = 40; y < 1040 && hit == ""; y += 4) { for (int x = 40; x < 1880 && hit == ""; x += 4) { var r = p.Pick(new Godot.Vector2(x, y)); if (r.Target == DemoFactory.Prototypes.BeastArena.Ui.PickTarget.Person && r.Person != null && r.Person.Id == "g1") hit = x + "," + y; } } if (hit == "") throw new System.Exception("no-g1"); var parts = hit.Split(','); var mi = Main.GetType().GetMethod("OnWorldClicked", System.Reflection.BindingFlags.NonPublic | System.Reflection.BindingFlags.Instance); mi!.Invoke(Main, new object[] { new Godot.Vector2(int.Parse(parts[0]), int.Parse(parts[1])) }); var sf = Main.GetType().GetField("_selection", System.Reflection.BindingFlags.NonPublic | System.Reflection.BindingFlags.Instance); var sel = (DemoFactory.Prototypes.BeastArena.Ui.SelectionPanel)sf!.GetValue(Main)!; if (sel.SelectedId != "g1") throw new System.Exception("selected=" + sel.SelectedId + " at " + hit); return "selected " + hit;

label: 等选中面板刷新
选中面板「卖明星」那一颗：这一按就是 SellStar 动词
卖明星那一发成了：留名账多一笔
还债的前置条件：记一笔 100 金的债（eval 只摆条件）
债写在头部段那一格
命令栏「经营」：开经营弹层
切到「账本与工资」那一栏（非当前栏的控件不可见，先切栏才点得动）
eval: var f = Main.GetType().GetField("_operations", System.Reflection.BindingFlags.NonPublic | System.Reflection.BindingFlags.Instance); var op = (DemoFactory.Prototypes.BeastArena.Ui.OperationsPanel)f!.GetValue(Main)!; op.Tabs.CurrentTab = 1; return "tab=" + op.Tabs.CurrentTab;

label: 等账本那一栏刷新出那一行
账本那一栏「还清」那一颗：这一按就是 PayDebt 动词
还债那一发成了：头上那一格清空
收起经营弹层：不挡巨兽面板
eval: var f = Main.GetType().GetField("_operations", System.Reflection.BindingFlags.NonPublic | System.Reflection.BindingFlags.Instance); ((DemoFactory.Prototypes.BeastArena.Ui.OperationsPanel)f!.GetValue(Main)!).Close(); return "closed";

label: 进阶的前置条件：备齐三本账（40 魂石 / 10 特殊材料 / 2000 金币），再挖开 0 号象限第 1 层（eval 只摆条件）
eval: var w = Main.World!; w.Town.ProduceSoulStone(100.0); w.Town.ProduceSpecialMaterial(20.0); w.Town.ProduceCoin(5000.0); w.Soil.BeginDigging(0, 1, 3, w.Tick); return "dig1";

label: 等第 1 层挖开（3 人 · 1 游戏小时 = 600 步）
挖开 0 号象限第 2 层
eval: var w = Main.World!; if (!w.Soil.IsDug(0, 1)) throw new System.Exception("layer1 not dug"); w.Soil.BeginDigging(0, 2, 3, w.Tick); return "dig2";

label: 等第 2 层挖开
二阶门槛的后两项：洞穴清剿成功 + 嵌入 1 单位魔晶（eval 只摆条件）
eval: var w = Main.World!; if (!w.Soil.IsDug(0, 2)) throw new System.Exception("layer2 not dug"); w.Soil.MarkCaveCleared(0, 2); w.Town.ProduceCrystal(1.0); w.EmbedCrystal(0, 2); if (!w.GateMet(DemoFactory.Prototypes.BeastArena.Logic.BeastTier.Tier2)) throw new System.Exception("gate not met"); return "embedded";

label: 嵌入写在土壤段那一格
俯视甲板，点兽身开巨兽面板（走玩家那一条左键入口）
eval: if (!Main.World!.Soil.IsDug(0, 2)) throw new System.Exception("layer2 not dug"); var b = Main.World.Voyage.Position; Main.CameraSetPose((float)b.X, (float)b.Z, 105f, 205f, 80f); var p = Main.Picker; string hit = ""; for (int y = 40; y < 1040 && hit == ""; y += 4) { for (int x = 40; x < 1880 && hit == ""; x += 4) { var r = p.Pick(new Godot.Vector2(x, y)); if (r.Target == DemoFactory.Prototypes.BeastArena.Ui.PickTarget.Beast) hit = x + "," + y; } } if (hit == "") throw new System.Exception("no-beast"); var parts = hit.Split(','); var mi = Main.GetType().GetMethod("OnWorldClicked", System.Reflection.BindingFlags.NonPublic | System.Reflection.BindingFlags.Instance); mi!.Invoke(Main, new object[] { new Godot.Vector2(int.Parse(parts[0]), int.Parse(parts[1])) }); var bf = Main.GetType().GetField("_beastPanel", System.Reflection.BindingFlags.NonPublic | System.Reflection.BindingFlags.Instance); var bp = (Godot.Control)bf!.GetValue(Main)!; if (!bp.Visible) throw new System.Exception("beast-panel-closed at " + hit); return "opened " + hit;

label: 等巨兽面板刷新
巨兽面板「进阶」那一颗：这一按就是 AdvanceTier 动词
进阶那一发成了
等仪式走完（1 游戏小时 = 600 步）
位阶真的到二阶
